entities.summary: The Monastery of the Corpus Christi is located in the municipality of Llutxent (Valencia), Spain. The convent building has its origins in an hermitage of the 13th century and was renovated in the 18th century. This monastery presents buildings from different eras, beginning the edification in the 14th century.
